page_size.note: Apple Silicon hosts commonly use 16 KiB pages. NOT measured here.

hinted_mapping_may_relocate.source: POSIX mmap: addr is a hint and the implementation may place the mapping elsewhere

fixed_noreplace_available.note: no equivalent of MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE was established for this platform

write_execute_simultaneous.note: this platform family is documented to enforce write-xor-execute for most processes

unavailable_ranges.note: the ROADMAP's motivating incident reports this band as unavailable to a translated x86-64 process. Transcribed, NOT measured.

warnings: NOTHING IN THIS PROFILE WAS MEASURED. It exists so that the analyzer's behaviour on a hostile address-space layout can be regression-tested, and so that the confidence ceiling can be demonstrated: every finding derived from these heuristic_risk facts is capped at PREDICTIVE, never PROVEN.
